about.title: Los Banos Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Los Banos residents rely on all kinds of manufactured goods every day, from farm equipment and vehicles traveling Rt 152 and Rt 165 to appliances and tools used at home. When one of these products fails because of a design flaw, a manufacturing error, or a missing warning, the resulting injury can upend daily life fast. California law allows injured people to pursue compensation from manufacturers, distributors, or retailers without having to prove anyone acted carelessly — the defect itself is often enough. We handle product liability cases on contingency, which means there's no upfront cost, and you owe nothing unless your case results in a recovery. If a defective product hurt you or someone you love in Los Banos, it helps to have the product preserved and to speak with us before too much time passes.

whyChoose.title: Why Los Banos Residents Choose Us

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify Your Claim
items.desc: California generally doesn't require proof that a manufacturer was careless — showing the product was defective and caused harm can be enough. That can make pursuing a claim more straightforward than other injury cases.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and retailers can all potentially be held liable for a defective product. Our team can help identify every party connected to what caused your injury.

items.title: Guidance on Preserving Evidence
items.desc: Keeping the product itself, along with packaging and receipts, is often critical to a defective product case. Our team can advise you early on how to protect that evidence.

items.question: Do I need to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Under California's strict liability approach, you generally need to show the product had a defect and that the defect caused your injury, rather than proving carelessness. We can review your situation to see how this applies to your specific claim.

items.question: What if the product was damaged after my crash on Rt 152 or Rt 165?
items.answer: Try to preserve whatever remains of the product, including any parts, packaging, or vehicle components involved. Even damaged pieces can matter for an inspection, so avoid discarding or repairing anything until you've spoken with us.

items.question: Is there a cost to contact you?
items.answer: No. We handle product liability cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation. Contact us today for a free case review.
